title: Hitachi Vantara notifies employees that April 2025 intrusion exposed Social Security numbers and salary data
date_note: Date of Hitachi Vantara's notice letter (19 November 2026), filed with the California Attorney General. The letter says the incident occurred on 26 April 2025 and was first reported to employees on 20 May 2025, so the intrusion itself is far older than the map window.
place: United States (the notice gives no headquarters city)
geo_basis: country only: the notice states no headquarters; its return address is the notice vendor's
summary: Hitachi Vantara's notice to the California Attorney General says it detected suspicious activity on its servers on April 26, 2025, and an unauthorized third party accessed files with personal information of employees of Hitachi Vantara and four related units, including Pentaho. After a review completed June 29, 2026, the filed letter lists Social Security numbers, salary, home address and race or ethnic origin. It reports no indication of misuse.
plain: Hitachi Vantara is telling employees that an intruder in April 2025 reached files with their Social Security numbers, salaries and home addresses. The company says it has seen no sign the data was misused.
exec: Employee HR records, including Social Security numbers and salary data, at a Hitachi technology unit were accessed; identity-fraud risk for staff.
action: Hitachi Vantara's notice advises affected employees to review financial statements and credit reports, and says U.S. employees can use the free Experian credit monitoring in Hitachi's employee benefits; questions go to its help line at 1-833-319-8595.
impact: Employees of Hitachi Vantara and four related Hitachi units; the notice gives no total number of people.

sources.name: Hitachi Vantara notice of data breach, 19 November 2026 (California Attorney General file)
California Attorney General breach listing: Hitachi Vantara LLC

validation.note: Primary: Hitachi Vantara's own notice letter, read in full from the California Attorney General's register (listing gives breach date 26 April 2025). The notice names no attacker and no attack type.

report.note: Notice letter read in full (3 pages).

review.note: Compared title, dates (26 Apr 2025, 19 Nov 2026 letter, 29 Jun 2026 review), five entities, data types, no-misuse wording, advice and help line against the notice letter.
